subject.title: [Feature]: Add description and enum to message tool's channel parameter

question: Should the shared message-tool schema add only provider-oriented guidance, or should it also enforce a dynamically derived enum that can reject previously accepted arbitrary `channel` strings before routing fallback runs?
rationale: The description is a narrow usability clarification, but an enum changes a model-facing validation contract across bundled and external channel plugins and can alter existing fallback behavior.

options.title: Land description-only guidance
options.body: Clarify that `channel` is a provider or channel-plugin identifier and retain current permissive validation plus runtime fallback behavior.

options.title: Add a dynamic enum with compatibility proof
options.body: Derive stable values from registered channel/plugin identifiers and prove fresh, plugin, and fallback behavior before changing validation.

options.title: Defer the enum decision
options.body: Land no schema constraint until maintainers define the permanent plugin/catalog contract for model-facing channel selection.

recommendation.title: Land description-only guidance
recommendation.body: Clarify that `channel` is a provider or channel-plugin identifier and retain current permissive validation plus runtime fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The prior review already assessed the exact schema, fallback, and registry boundary that this decision affects.
